notes.title: Linux experimental version released
notes.notes:
A Linux version of the game is released.

The game was Tested with Ubuntu 18 LTS and it works perfectly.

A 64bit version of the app is created. Only 64 bits version of the game is available. I don't have plans to distribute a 32 bits version.

If anyone finds any bug, please report the bug and say which OS version you are using, thanks.

notes.title: Mac OS version released
notes.notes:
Now Robot Warriors are available on Mac OS now.

The game was tested with MacOS Big Sur and it works.

A 32bit and 64bit version of the app is created. This means that the game should be playable on MacOs Mojave(32 bits OS) and some earlier version of Mac OS.

If anyone find any bug, please report the bug and say which OS version you are using, thanks.

notes.title: Fix game freeze bug
notes.notes:
A new update is released to fix the bug that freeze the game when low graphic graphics are used.
The low graphic options are now removed from the game.

notes.title: MiniMap included
notes.notes:
Now you can easily find where the enemies are.
Just check on the Mini Map on the top right part of the screen.
You can zoom in and zoom out on the map, just use the "-" button and the "+" button on your keyboard.
